title: [WIP] Evaluate various effective component animation testing methods
body:
- [x] Analyze broken documentation pages on fumadocs site
- [x] Identify root cause: `InteractiveDemo` doesn't provide `SchemaRendererContext`, causing plugin pages to crash with "useSchemaContext must be used within a SchemaRendererProvider"
- [x] Fix `InteractiveDemo` to wrap content with `DemoProvider` (uses `SchemaRendererContext.Provider` directly to avoid bundling issues)
- [x] Add `Array.isArray` guards in resizable, list, tree-view, and table components to prevent `.map is not a function` TypeError during SSG prerendering
- [x] Verify docs site builds successfully (475/475 static pages generated)
- [x] Add `e2e/docs-smoke.spec.ts` — Playwright smoke tests covering 20 representative doc pages across all categories (components, fields, core, plugins, blocks)
- [ ] Update CI workflow to run docs e2e tests (would add a `docs-e2e` job with separate Playwright config targeting the docs site)
- [ ] Run code review and security checks

### Changes

**`apps/site/app/components/InteractiveDemo.tsx`**
- Import `SchemaRendererContext` from `@object-ui/react`
- Add `DemoProvider` wrapper that provides a minimal `SchemaRendererContext` so plugin components (grid, kanban, calendar, etc.) can find the required context
- Wrap both single-example and multi-example `SchemaRenderer` usage with `DemoProvider`

**`packages/components/src/renderers/complex/resizable.tsx`**
- Add `Array.isArray(schema.panels)` guard before `.map()` to prevent SSG prerender crashes

**`packages/components/src/renderers/data-display/list.tsx`**
- Add `Array.isArray` guard for `items` to prevent `.map()` on non-array values

**`packages/components/src/renderers/data-display/tree-view.tsx`**
- Add `Array.isArray` guard for `nodes` to prevent `.map()` on non-array values

**`packages/components/src/renderers/data-display/table.tsx`**
- Add `Array.isArray` guard for `columns` to prevent `.map()` on non-array values

**`e2e/docs-smoke.spec.ts`** (new)
- Playwright smoke tests for 20 representative doc pages
- Checks for HTTP errors, uncaught JS exceptions, and Next.js error overlays
- Checks that all JS/CSS bundles load without 404s
